entries.title: Prey

primary.why: The 2006 Prey released on Windows and Xbox 360, with later Mac and Linux client routes. Windows is the best archive route because it is the original PC release with the strongest capture/settings and preservation path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original Windows release if owned, applying community fixes. Treat later Arkane Prey as a separate entry, not a remake of this game.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC route with best capture/settings path.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity route for the 2006 game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate with Arkane's 2017 Prey. The announced Prey 2 was canceled and is not a playable entry.

entries.title: Prey Invasion

primary.why: Prey Invasion is a distinct iOS spin-off based on the 2006 Prey, released for iPhone/iPod touch. No official modern port is sourced, so the original iOS release is the archival target.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legitimately retained iOS install on compatible legacy hardware if available; otherwise preserve captures and metadata.

all_releases.fidelity: Only sourced official platform; legacy mobile preservation route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one official platform is sourced.

entries.remaster_caveats: Legacy mobile spin-off; not a port of Arkane's 2017 Prey.

entries.title: Prey: Mooncrash
entries.definitive_edition: Mooncrash DLC with Typhon Hunter update on Windows

primary.version: Mooncrash DLC with Typhon Hunter update
primary.why: Mooncrash is the major Prey (2017) expansion, and the Typhon Hunter multiplayer update is free for Mooncrash/Digital Deluxe owners. Windows is the best archive route because it has the strongest capture/settings path and well-supported PC components.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows version of Prey with Mooncrash installed. Then document Typhon Hunter/TranStar VR only if the current build and multiplayer/VR setup are functional.
